full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white cinematic image shows a line of armed travelers walking toward the viewer across rough ground beneath a pale misty sky. The nearest figure stands at the left foreground, enlarged by perspective and nearly solid black. A broad circular hat hides the face, while a heavy layered coat hangs around the body and a long narrow object angles down beside the leg. Near the center, another tall hatted figure advances with both arms low, its outline dark and firm against the bright background. Smaller companions trail between and to the right of these two: several round hats, narrow shoulders, hanging garments, and slender carried objects remain visible as gray silhouettes within the haze. The line recedes unevenly across the middle distance rather than forming a perfectly straight row. Along the bottom, coarse grass and broken earth appear almost black, with individual blades rising against the figures' ankles. The upper two-thirds are mostly empty gray-white air, slightly darker near the top and bright behind the walkers. Their faces and clothing details are obscured by backlight and distance, so posture and hat shapes carry the scene. Light comes from behind the group through diffuse mist, throwing their bodies into shadow and creating soft halos along some outer edges. The foreground remains grainy and sharply textured, while the farther figures lose contrast. The overall composition sets a staggered dark procession against a large quiet sky, using depth, repetition, and silhouette for a solemn, anticipatory mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白电影画面呈现一列持武器的行人，穿过苍白雾气下的粗糙地面，朝观者走来。最近的人站在左侧前景，因透视而显得很大，几乎成为实心黑影。宽大的圆形帽子遮住脸，厚重层叠外衣垂在身上，一件细长物品沿腿旁斜向下方。中央附近另一名戴帽的高个人物双臂下垂前进，深色轮廓在明亮背景前十分明确。较小的同伴跟在两人之间和右侧：几顶圆帽、窄肩、下垂衣物与细长携带物在薄雾中作为灰色剪影尚可辨认。这列人沿中景参差后退，而非排成完全笔直的一行。底部粗草与破碎泥地近乎漆黑，单根草叶从人物脚踝前升起。上方三分之二区域大多是空旷的灰白空气，顶部稍暗，行人身后更亮。逆光与距离掩去了脸和服装细节，姿态与帽形承担了场景识别。光从人群后方经漫射薄雾照来，让身体沉入阴影，部分外缘出现柔和亮边。前景仍颗粒明显、质地清楚，远处人物则逐渐失去反差。整体构图以宽阔安静的天空衬托错落的深色队列，凭借纵深、重复和剪影形成庄重而充满期待的气氛。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white cinematic treatment uses strong backlighting to turn detailed forms into staggered silhouettes. The tonal range moves from nearly solid foreground black through soft middle gray to a broad pale field, with no colored accents. Coarse grain and sharp irregular marks concentrate near the bottom, while distance progressively softens contours and lowers contrast. Repeated upright forms and rounded horizontal accents make a slow visual rhythm across the center. The brightest region sits behind the middle group, so dark shapes remain legible without interior modeling. Large negative space above gives the lower arrangement weight and scale. The overall effect is austere, atmospheric, and solemn.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白电影式处理以强烈逆光把细节丰富的形体压成错落剪影。明度范围从前景近乎实心的黑色，经柔和中灰，到宽阔浅色区域，没有彩色重音。粗颗粒与清晰的不规则痕迹集中在底部，距离增加时轮廓逐渐柔化、对比逐渐降低。重复的直立形体与圆润的水平顶端在中部形成缓慢节奏。最亮区域位于中央群体后方，使暗形无需内部塑形仍然清楚。上方大片负空间赋予下方形体排列重量与尺度。整体效果严峻、富有空气感且庄重。
theme_en: A line of armed travelers approaching through monochrome mist
theme_zh: 一列持武器的行人穿过单色薄雾走来
name: Seven Samurai
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
